actions: Replace noun-swapped event curriculum with independently authored scenarios across everyday dialogue, explanation, instructions, factual grounding, planning and uncertainty.
Vary arithmetic totals, comparison direction, capacity outcomes and schedules; validate answers with deterministic oracles.
Generate first replies without access to future user turns, then generate follow-ups conditioned on the actual first reply.
Use exact gpt-6-luna with high reasoning for a bounded calibration before considering volume; measure quality/usage rather than assuming the setting fixes it.
Build heldout task/scenario families before model evaluation; preserve all current failed cases as regression tests.
Keep the own-foundation/random-init/under-100M requirement. Rebind and recheck the trainer on accepted data before any weight update.
